methods.note: Text-supported: HotSpot 6.0 steady grid (p2, p5), Black's model (p2, p6), Eq. 3 power from PrimeTime energy/bit times flit counts (p5, p7), manual layout comparison with no optimizer or controller (p4, p9), and transient temperature mentioned but not evaluated (p5). But experiment.kind is 'custom_2d_steady' while steady_2d_relevant is false and the extraction lists essential 3D/TSV/bonding-layer/monolithic mismatches. A 3D stack must not be labelled a 2D steady reproduction. The Figure 10 comparison was not visually verified.

code.note: The packet has no assets and no code, HotSpot config, .flp, .ptrace or layer files. The five linked URLs (patent, Renesas and Toshiba handbooks, NanGate, FreePDK3D45) are bare reference links. They were not opened and prove nothing about experiment inputs. The execution-time note (C++/Python/Bash, p10) names no repo.

parameters.note: Router static power is 7.66e-4 W in the p7 text but 7.64e-4 W in Table 2 (p7). Energy per bit is 9.246e-13 in the text but 9.2546e-13 in Table 2. Table 2 energy 2.9022496e-8 J / 31360 bits = 9.2547e-13, so the extraction's normalized 9.246e-13 follows the text typo rather than the arithmetically consistent value. Table 3 TSV area '35,700 um2 / 10.16%' is inconsistent with a 290x290 um tile (10.16% is about 8,545 um2) and is unexplained. Table 3 resistivities are plausible as m·K/W: Cu 0.0025 corresponds to 400 W/mK. The extraction still labels them unverified. Table 1 vs text: 1/0.011537 is about 87x, not the stated 220x at 30 C.

config.note: No layer thicknesses, bonding-layer thickness, heatsink or package parameters, ambient temperature, HotSpot layer-config file, or Studio package/material assumptions (studio_assumptions is empty). Only the Table 3 sizes and resistivities are given. Floorplan x/y placement is absent, and Figure 2(c) and Figure 4 were not visually inspected.

data.note: No same-scenario per-router power in W for any floorplan block. Figure 8 (p8) and Figure 10 (p9) values exist only as charts, and no figure images were supplied, only pdftotext output. The one decisive number, 351.64 K = 78.49 C (p9 text), is verified as text and 351.64-273.15 = 78.49. Its layer, router and benchmark are unspecified. The floorplan list and power_w are empty, so the scenario cannot be matched.

findings.reason: The extraction sets kind 'custom_2d_steady' with empty floorplan and power_w, yet it declares steady_2d_relevant=false and lists essential 3D mismatches (3 layers, bonding/TIM, TSV paths, top heatsink, monolithic comparison). The experiment is a 3D/TSV scenario mislabelled as 2D steady, and it is also empty.

The text (7.66e-4 W) and Table 2 (7.64e-4 W) disagree. The extraction records both but normalizes the text value to a single block 'router'. It does not resolve the conflict and the value is not a stacked-scenario per-block power.

findings.reason: artifact_search_status 'checked_links_found' overstates things: the URLs are reference and background links, none were fetched, and no asset is in the packet. The patent URL was reconstructed from a line-wrapped PDF string, and the cited patent number (10,181,454) does not match the URL's application number.

The mK/W units in Table 3 are marked 'presumably', but they could be verified by physical plausibility (Cu 0.0025 m·K/W = 400 W/mK). Conversion factors of 1e-6 for um were not independently checked against figure geometry. The Table 3 TSV area and utilization entry is internally inconsistent with the 290 um tile.

Table 1 gives about 87x for 30 C vs 70 C, while the text says 220x. The text also says 'less than 2%' while Table 1 shows 1.15%. The Black's-model parameters (Ea, n, J) are not given, so the reliability data cannot be reproduced.
